notes: GATED run. The ungated R2 run 35104707504 measured 1,246 signals with P(reach 10%|signal) = 22.55%, and its strength contrast separated the group that carried past 10% from the rest on three signal-time features: they fired at roughly half the bar index (7.8 vs 15.6), were already stronger when signalled (8.32% vs 5.41%), and had ranged far more the PREVIOUS day (8.61% vs 5.88%). Close location did not separate at all (0.895 vs 0.924) and is deliberately not gated on. This run applies the three separating features as gates -- min_chg_pct 7.0, max_bar_index 10, min_prior_day_range_pct 7.0 -- to measure whether P(reach 10%|signal) rises materially above the 22.55% ungated baseline and at what cost in signal count. Mean differences are a lead, not a validated filter; this run is what tests them.
